title: Workshop material ledger
instructions: Build a complete command-line program for workshop material totals. This is an original Notedra context and format, not an official past exam.

Each input line is AREA~material~units. AREA is 1–8 uppercase ASCII letters, material is 1–12 lowercase ASCII letters, and units is a canonical decimal integer from 0 through 1000. Every physical line is a record; empty input is valid. No whitespace trimming is allowed.

Model MaterialKey(area, material) with value equality/hashCode and StockEntry(key, units) by composition. Aggregate units for equal keys. Sort by area, then material. Output AREA/material=total with one literal newline per key.

LedgerCli.run(args, out, err) takes exactly input and output paths, returns 0 on success, 1 for an input/output error and 2 for invalid argument count. Print Wrote N totals. on success. Report malformed lines with their 1-based line number. Parse before opening the output.

Budget suggestion: establish model and contracts, implement parser, process one example, connect CLI, then test boundary/error cases. Component rubrics describe evidence to inspect; completing this program does not automatically mark every associated skill correct.
Notedra authored practice. The time class is a suggested practice budget, not an official assessment duration.
Write and review your own attempt before revealing the reference. Code on this page is ephemeral and is not compiled, run or automatically graded. Multiple correct implementations are valid.

requirements.text: Separate immutable key, entry, parser, aggregation and CLI responsibilities; validate key grammar and nonnegative bounded entry units.
Use both key fields in equals/hashCode; equal independently constructed keys must aggregate together without treating a hash collision as equality.
Read all lines into model objects; reject malformed data with its physical line number and do not silently repair it.
Sum units per value key using long totals and produce the specified deterministic area/material order.
Implement the declared argument/status/output contract and resource ownership; malformed input must leave an existing output unchanged.
Use component tests for equality, model validation, repeated keys, empty data, malformed input, resource boundaries and CLI status; prioritize a working vertical slice before optional cleanup.
